description: Model Context Protocol server giving Claude Desktop and Claude CLI structured, queryable access to live Family Pulse data. Enables conversational financial analysis without screen scraping. Runs as stdio or local HTTP server on Tailscale only.

timing.gatingCondition: Feature 4 complete (budget data available). Can be developed in parallel with Features 5-7.

principles: Read-only access — MCP tools query data, never modify it
Structured responses — return typed data, not rendered HTML or prose
Tailscale-scoped — server only accessible on tailnet, never public
Tools should be composable — Claude can combine multiple tool calls to answer complex questions

SECRETS INVARIANT — MCP tool responses never include access tokens, .env values, or items table secrets. Only user-facing data: account names, balances, transactions, categories. Enforced by secrets-guard module and response schema validation tests.

techStack.testing: Jest for tool handler unit tests, MCP Inspector for integration

userStories.title: MCP server scaffold and transport
acceptanceCriteria: Supports stdio transport for Claude Code CLI
Connects to Family Pulse PostgreSQL database (read-only connection)
PM2 process config for persistent operation
Installable in Claude Code config on ThinkPad T14s
userStories.testStrategy: Server starts without error. MCP Inspector connection test. Database connectivity test.

userStories.title: Account and balance tools
acceptanceCriteria: Tool: get_account_balances — returns all accounts with current balances, grouped by member
Tool: get_savings_signal — returns liquid savings total, signal status (tight/comfortable/splurge-ready), threshold info
Response schema: typed JSON with account names (no access tokens or raw IDs)
userStories.testStrategy: Unit tests for response schema. No sensitive data in responses.

userStories.title: Transaction query tool
acceptanceCriteria: Tool: get_transactions — query by date_range, category, account, include_transfers (boolean)
Returns: date, merchant, amount, category, account_name
Summary mode: return aggregated totals instead of individual transactions
Transfers excluded by default unless explicitly requested
userStories.testStrategy: Query filter tests (each parameter). Pagination test. Summary mode aggregation test. Transfer exclusion test.

userStories.title: Budget and planning tools
acceptanceCriteria: Tool: get_budget_status — current month budget vs. actual by category, with percentages
Tool: get_cash_flow_summary — net cash flow for any specified period
Tool: get_anomalies — current unacknowledged spending anomalies
Tool: get_planning_goals — all planning goals with target, current, projected date
userStories.testStrategy: Each tool returns correct data format. Budget status matches dashboard calculations. Cash flow period handling test.

high: MCP server must never expose Plaid access tokens or raw database IDs in tool responses
medium: Query performance — complex transaction queries could be slow, need appropriate indexes
MCP SDK version compatibility with Claude Code CLI version
low: stdio vs HTTP transport decision — stdio is simpler but limits concurrent access

Decide: stdio or HTTP transport (or both)?
